title: Mussels with cream, celery and fennel
blurb: Fresh mussels steamed in white wine with aromatic celery and fennel seeds, finished with cream and parsley.
steps: Rinse the mussels under cold water, scrub the shells and pull away any beards. Discard any mussels that are open and do not close when tapped.
Finely dice the celery and peel and slice the garlic. Coarsely grind the fennel seeds in a pestle and mortar.
Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat and add the celery, garlic and fennel seeds. Cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Add the mussels and wine to the pot, cover with a tight lid and turn the heat to high. Steam for 5 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally.
Remove the lid and discard any mussels that have not opened. Pour in the cream and let it warm through for 1 minute.
Roughly chop the parsley and stir it through the mussels with a grinding of black pepper. Serve immediately in bowls with the cooking liquor.
